'''Avywenna''' is a 5★ [[Electric]] [[Striker]] [[Operator]] from the [[TGCC]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. She is a [[Polearm]] user who can throw Thunderlances into the battlefield and use her battle skill to retrieve all thrown lances at once, dealing massive {{Color|Electric DMG|6}} at one go.

==Profile==
"Messengers have to safely deliver plenty of secrets, and every one of them comes with a costly price tag. But there is one thing more expensive than the delivery itself, and that is ... my silence on these matters."<br/>Avywenna is an Armed Messenger.<br/>Before joining [[Endfield Industries]], she lived with a powerful logistics family in the Free City of Alloycarrot. Yet the wanderlust in her blood drove her to leave that life and begin her own journey. Across the many destinations of [[Talos-II]], she discovered a thread that bound them together — the mysterious [[Endministrator]].<br/>Avywenna shines in social settings, handling all kinds of relationships with maturity and professionalism. As to whether she's truly as good-tempered as she seems, you'll have to find out by engaging with her yourself.<br/>"Nobody likes insolence ... so if we can talk things out, I'd much rather do that than get physical. But just so we're clear, I don't tolerate insolence well either."
